title: Greatclub
summary: Minotaur-only greatclub dealing 2d12 Bludgeoning. Humanoids cannot wield it.

fields.Weapon profile: 2d12 Bludgeoning, 5 ft melee. Simple, two-handed and dippable.
fields.Tenacity: While main-handed, on a missed melee attack use your Reaction to deal Strength modifier Bludgeoning, minimum 1. It does not apply a missed weapon action’s effect.
fields.Availability: Obtain by disarming a Minotaur. Cannot be equipped by humanoids, even with Gloves of the Automaton.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
